_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Public Cloud d'abord (hypercroissance, segment transformateur, marges en hausse). Hybrid Cloud ensuite (coeur historique). Support Revenue (recurrent stable). Americas (geo principal). Public Cloud Gross Margin (rentabilite segment cle).

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance segment transformateur, marges en hausse 67% to 75% FY25
kpis.description_fr: Segment Public Cloud : services cloud (Azure NetApp Files, AWS FSx, Spot, Instaclustr). Croissance soutenue, marge brute 75.2% FY25 (vs 66.8% FY24), segment qui change la trajectoire NetApp.
kpis.description_en: Public Cloud segment: cloud services (Azure NetApp Files, AWS FSx, Spot, Instaclustr). Strong growth, 75.2% gross margin FY25 (vs 66.8% FY24), transformative segment.

kpis.signal: Coeur historique 90% du CA, retour a la croissance FY25 via All-Flash C-Series
kpis.description_fr: Segment Hybrid Cloud : storage on-prem (ONTAP arrays, AFF A-Series, AFF C-Series, hybrid systems). Coeur historique NetApp, ~90% du CA. Retour a la croissance FY25 grace aux ventes All-Flash C-Series.
kpis.description_en: Hybrid Cloud segment: on-prem storage (ONTAP arrays, AFF A-Series, AFF C-Series, hybrid systems). NetApp historical core, ~90% of revenue. Growth resumed FY25 driven by C-Series all-flash array sales.

kpis.signal: Revenu recurrent stable, base installee monetisee, marge brute 92%
kpis.description_fr: CA support et maintenance (contrats software et hardware support). Revenu recurrent stable, base installee monetisee. Marge brute ~92% FY25.
kpis.description_en: Support and maintenance revenue (software and hardware support contracts). Stable recurring revenue from installed base. ~92% gross margin FY25.

kpis.signal: Zone Americas ~51% du CA, retour a la croissance FY25
kpis.description_fr: CA zone Americas (US, Canada, Amerique Latine). Principal marche NetApp ~51% du CA total FY25.
kpis.description_en: Americas region revenue (US, Canada, Latin America). NetApp main market, ~51% of total revenue FY25.

kpis.signal: Expansion forte +8.4pts FY25, premium vs Hybrid Cloud
kpis.description_fr: Marge brute du segment Public Cloud. Expansion forte +8.4pts FY25 a 75.2% (vs 66.8% FY24). Superieure a la marge Hybrid Cloud (70.6%).
kpis.description_en: Public Cloud segment gross margin. Strong expansion +8.4pts FY25 to 75.2% (vs 66.8% FY24). Above Hybrid Cloud margin (70.6%).
